# Copilot instructions

- Keep this app dependency-free: use Node.js built-ins and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS only.
- Keep functions in `src/stalls.js` pure and easy to test.
- Every bug fix must add a regression test in `test/`.
- Use Singapore time (`Asia/Singapore`) for anything time-related.
- Keep UI changes accessible with clear labels and sufficient contrast.
- Run `npm test` before finishing.
